release_notes: Three card-border refinements in the main window. (1) Modern Blue and Sage Clinic card borders are now slightly darker. Modern Blue card_border: #dde6f5 -> #bdc6d5; Sage Clinic card_border: #d4e4d5 -> #b4c4b5 (RGB -32 on each channel). The originals were so pastel that the panes looked borderless against the page background; the darker tones are still subtle but read clearly as a defined edge. Rose Quartz (#fbc9d4) is unchanged -- it was already dark enough. (2) Removed the inner border on the Ready Messages log panel. The outer 'Ready Messages' card already encloses the log; the RoundedLogPanel was drawing a second nested border in the same color a few pixels inside the first, which read as visual noise rather than separation. RoundedLogPanel is now constructed with border='' and _apply_theme passes None on theme switches. (3) Fixed the right/bottom clipping glitch on every RoundedCard. Tk centers a 1-pixel outline on the polygon vertex; with the polygon spanning the full canvas (0..w, 0..h), the half-width past x=w / y=h lands outside the canvas and gets clipped -- leaving the right and bottom edges rendering at half intensity (or invisibly on some themes). The polygon now spans (0..w-1, 0..h-1) so the full 1-pixel outline falls inside the canvas on all four sides. Cost: a 1px gutter on the right/bottom shows the canvas's outer_bg (the page background), which is effectively invisible against the surrounding layout. All four borders now render consistently at full strength.
